description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Hydraulic Engineering topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: hydraulic-engineering

facts.claim: Laminar pressure drop comes from viscosity (Hagen–Poiseuille)

source.quote: Poiseuille's equation describes the pressure drop due to the viscosity of the fluid

facts.claim: Transition is governed by the Reynolds number

source.quote: The main parameter characterizing transition is the Reynolds number

facts.claim: The boundary layer is a thin layer next to the surface where velocity is reduced

source.quote: a boundary layer is the thin layer of fluid in the immediate vicinity of a bounding surface
Such flow separation causes a large increase in the pressure drag

facts.claim: Dynamic similarity: force ratios are the same in model and prototype

source.quote: Dynamic similarity – ratios of all forces acting on corresponding fluid particles and boundary surfaces in the two systems are constant

facts.claim: Open channels have a free surface; flow is driven by gravity

source.quote: open-channel flow has a free surface, whereas pipe flow does not

facts.claim: Manning's formula gives mean velocity from roughness n, hydraulic radius and slope

source.quote: The Manning formula or Manning's equation is an empirical formula estimating the average velocity of a liquid in an open channel flow
is an empirically derived coefficient, which is dependent on many factors, including surface roughness

facts.claim: Froude number = inertia / gravity; critical flow at Fr = 1

source.quote: the Froude number (Fr, after William Froude, ) is a dimensionless number defined as the ratio of the flow inertia to the external force field

facts.claim: A jump changes supercritical flow to subcritical flow

source.quote: A hydraulic jump is always a transition from supercritical to subcritical flow

facts.claim: Depth rises suddenly while speed falls

source.quote: an abrupt increase in the depth of a fast-moving liquid stream in an open channel, which is accompanied by a decrease in speed

facts.claim: Darcy–Weisbach gives friction head loss in pipes

source.quote: the Darcy–Weisbach equation is an empirical equation that relates the head loss, or pressure loss, due to viscous shear forces

facts.claim: Sudden valve closure causes a pressure surge (wave)

source.quote: the pressure surge or wave caused when a fluid in motion is forced to stop or change direction suddenly

facts.claim: Reduced with surge tanks, accumulators or slow valve closure

source.quote: It is possible to reduce the effects of the water hammer pulses with accumulators, expansion tanks, surge tanks

facts.claim: CFD solves flow equations numerically on computers

facts.claim: Gravity drives open-channel flow; the Froude number matters most

source.quote: Due to the presence of a free surface, gravity is generally the most significant driver of open-channel flow
